bullets: Data Engineer with approximately 12 years of experience across enterprise data integration, SQL development, ETL/ELT processing, distributed data engineering, and analytical data platforms, with a focus on Scala, Apache Spark, PySpark, and Azure Databricks.
Skilled in designing Databricks data pipelines using Scala, Spark DataFrames, Datasets, notebooks, and Spark SQL for large-volume batch processing, incremental ingestion, and complex transformations.
Experienced in lakehouse architecture, Delta Lake storage, Bronze/Silver/Gold Medallion processing, schema evolution, data validation, and data warehouse integration.
Developed streaming ingestion solutions using Spark Structured Streaming, Databricks Auto Loader, checkpoint management, watermarking, and incremental Delta table operations.
Implemented Unity Catalog governance workflows covering catalogs, schemas, table-level privileges, controlled data access, and centralized management of analytical data assets.
Optimized Spark applications using execution-plan analysis, partition pruning, broadcast joins, shuffle reduction, caching, Adaptive Query Execution, and Databricks cluster sizing.
Built and maintained Databricks job orchestration workflows with parameterized notebooks, task dependencies, scheduling, retries, and monitoring of failed or delayed processing tasks.

Supported Azure data engineering operations through CI/CD troubleshooting, Azure DevOps pipelines, Databricks serverless compute evaluation, and integration with Docker, Kubernetes, and Azure Kubernetes Service.

experience.description: Enterprise data integration and analytical processing platform involving Azure Databricks, large-volume data ingestion, distributed Spark transformations, governed Delta Lake storage, and operational data pipeline orchestration.
responsibilities: Developed Azure Databricks ETL/ELT pipelines using Scala, PySpark, Spark SQL, and DataFrames to process large-volume enterprise operational datasets and publish curated analytical tables.
Designed Delta Lake Bronze, Silver, and Gold processing layers with schema validation, deduplication, incremental merge operations, and reusable transformation notebooks.
Implemented Databricks Auto Loader pipelines against Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 with schema tracking, checkpoint persistence, rescued-data handling, and restartable ingestion workflows.
Built Spark Structured Streaming applications using Scala and PySpark, incorporating watermarks, stateful aggregations, checkpoint directories, and Delta Lake streaming sinks.

Optimized expensive Spark joins and aggregation stages through broadcast join selection, repartitioning, skew analysis, and Adaptive Query Execution; evaluate processing-time reductions against recorded job-run baselines.

Configured Databricks job clusters using workload-specific worker sizing, autoscaling settings, executor memory analysis, and compute policies; compared serverless execution with traditional job-cluster configurations.
Configured Unity Catalog catalogs, schemas, and table grants to organize governed data assets and apply controlled access across ingestion and analytical processing layers.
Created Databricks Workflows with parameterized notebooks, dependent tasks, retry policies, scheduling, and alerting to coordinate ingestion, cleansing, enrichment, and publishing operations.

Diagnosed failed Spark stages, executor out-of-memory conditions, shuffle spills, schema mismatches, and Structured Streaming checkpoint failures using Spark UI, driver logs, and task execution details.

Troubleshot Azure DevOps pipeline failures, deployment variables, service connections, and containerized application dependencies involving Docker, Kubernetes, and AKS, coordinating corrections across platform and engineering teams.

experience.description: Healthcare data integration and analytical processing workflows involving provider records, operational datasets, distributed transformations, and curated reporting structures.
responsibilities: Developed Databricks notebooks using Scala, PySpark, and Spark SQL to integrate structured provider and operational datasets into standardized analytical processing layers.
Created Spark DataFrame transformations for provider identifier reconciliation, attribute normalization, duplicate detection, and preparation of curated reporting datasets.
Implemented Delta Lake tables with incremental loading, merge-based updates, schema enforcement, and historical data processing for downstream analytical consumption.
Built validation routines comparing source and target record counts, required-field completeness, and duplicate-key distributions; defined data quality indicators for release acceptance.
Optimized complex Spark SQL transformations through partition pruning, selective caching, join strategy improvements, and inspection of physical execution plans.
Organized Databricks notebook workflows with reusable processing functions, configurable parameters, scheduled execution, and recovery procedures for failed processing stages.
Investigated inconsistent source schemas, failed Spark tasks, invalid records, and SQL performance issues using notebook logs, execution plans, and data reconciliation queries.
Worked with reporting and application stakeholders to translate healthcare analytical requirements into dimensional datasets, transformation rules, and data validation procedures.

experience.description: Transportation operations data engineering workflows supporting batch ingestion, distributed data processing, operational reporting, and historical analytical datasets.
responsibilities: Developed Scala-based Apache Spark applications to ingest transportation operations records from structured files and relational source systems.
Implemented Spark DataFrame and Dataset transformations for operational event consolidation, service activity aggregation, and standardized reporting outputs.
Created SQL-based ETL processing routines to cleanse source data, validate business identifiers, and load curated datasets into reporting structures.
Developed incremental processing logic using source update timestamps and persisted processing checkpoints to limit unnecessary full-data reloads.
Analyzed Spark execution stages and shuffle behavior to identify skewed partitions, excessive intermediate data movement, and inefficient joins.
Refactored transformation logic using appropriate partition counts, projection pushdown, broadcast joins, and reusable Scala processing components.
Troubleshot failed batch processing tasks, malformed source records, schema changes, and memory-related execution issues using application logs and Spark diagnostics.

experience.role: Data Engineer - Big Data and SQL
experience.description: Advertising campaign data processing and reporting integration involving structured data ingestion, SQL transformations, distributed batch processing, and analytical data preparation.
responsibilities: Developed SQL ETL routines to consolidate advertising campaign, placement, and operational reporting data from multiple structured sources.
Implemented Scala and Apache Spark batch transformations for larger campaign datasets, including joins, filtering, normalization, and aggregated reporting outputs.
Created source-to-target reconciliation checks to identify missing campaign records, duplicate identifiers, inconsistent attribute mappings, and mismatched reporting totals.
Designed staging tables and analytical data structures supporting historical campaign reporting and dimensional aggregations.
Optimized SQL transformations by reviewing execution plans, refining filtering conditions, and reducing repeated processing of unchanged source records.
Improved operational recovery procedures through validation checkpoints, exception logging, restartable batch steps, and documented data mapping rules.

experience.description: Financial application data integration workflows involving relational database processing, SQL transformations, data validation, and structured reporting pipelines.
responsibilities: Developed SQL queries and database procedures to extract, transform, and prepare structured financial application records for downstream reporting systems.
Implemented scheduled ETL processing routines to populate staging tables and reporting datasets from transactional and reference data sources.
Created validation queries to identify duplicate transaction records, missing values, referential integrity violations, and source-to-target discrepancies.
Reviewed SQL execution plans and query filtering patterns to address inefficient joins, repeated scans, and unnecessary intermediate processing.
Investigated failed data loads and inconsistent records using database error messages, processing logs, and targeted reconciliation queries.
Documented transformation specifications, source-to-target mappings, processing dependencies, and operational recovery procedures.
